decisions.question: How long may the server wait for in-flight requests after SIGTERM before it exits?
decisions.resolution: Stop accepting connections at once, then wait up to 10 seconds for in-flight requests before exiting.
decisions.reason: Uploads of large snippets over slow links take several seconds, and 10 seconds lets them complete.
decisions.alternative: Exit at once and drop in-flight requests.

decisions.question: Which address does the server listen on by default?
decisions.reason: A local default does not expose the service by accident.
